On Thu, Jun 16, 2022 at 1:17 PM Dessy Septiane Sukendar < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Yth. Pak Qi'sai and USAID team,
Thanks again for the follow up. Happy to share this morning both Meta and Love
Frankie we arrived on a format we are comfortable with that works best to reflect
the contents of the partnership that we are embarking on for the University
Challenge.
At Love Frankie's consent sharing a copy here for your reference. If you have any
questions, please do connect with either Matt or me.
Hope this helps and thanks again for your patience.
Dessy

From: Ahmad Qisa'i <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, May 18, 2022 8:58 AM
To: Dessy Septiane Sukendar ‹ [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Shanti Alexander < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Ignatius Indriartoto
<[contact omitted]>; Yahya Luping <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: MoU with USAID
Hi Dessy,
I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to you to touch base with you in the hope of
receiving an update from you and the Meta team with regards to my email below.
Ilook forward to hearing from you.
Thankyou.
Salam,
Qisa'i
On Wed, Apr 20, 2022 at 9:11 AM Ahmad Qisa'i <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Dessy,
How are you? Hope all is well with you.
I just want to check with you the follow up of our discussion on March 30 about the draft letter
you are preparing for the upcoming collaboration between Meta and USAID on the digital
literacy project. Any update that you can share with us?
An update from our side is that we have discussed with our GDA PSE-AP Activity Manager in
the headquarters about the required MoU under any GDA PSE-AP activity.
After explaining the inability of Meta to have such a required document under the GDA PSE-
AP, our Activity Manager has agreed to give a waiver on this MoU. We are no longer required
to develop and sign any MoU but he still required us to agree on any supporting document
that both parties (Meta and USAID) have agreed to collaborate on this project as has been
elaborated in the program description.
To follow this up, I think we need to meet and discuss sooner than later, considering the
timeline we have set for this program to run, i.e. June 2022.
Thank you and I'm looking forward to talking to you.
Salam,
Qisa'i
On Wed, Mar 16, 2022 at 4:34 PM Ahmad Qisa'i <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Dessy,
As part of the ongoing co-creation process with Love Frankie and the requirement under the
GDA PSE-AP procurement process, an MoU needs to be developed between USAID
Indonesia and Meta Indonesia. My question is whether Meta regional office has past MoU
with USAID/RDMA during its engagement in Thailand? If you do have that one, would it be
possible for you to share it? This can be the basis for us to develop the MoU between
USAID Indonesia and Meta Indonesia.
Additionally, during that engagement with USAID in Thailand, do you have any information
of a due diligence process in place?
Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.

Salam,
Qisa'l
--
Ahmad Qisa'i, Ph.D
Anti-Corruption Advisor
Office of Democratic Resilience and Governance
USAID/Indonesia
